quotes.text: Cross-calendar move calls destination `addItem()` before source `deleteItem()`; deletion can fail after creation and leave duplicates, which supports basic failed-move recovery. Revision-checked storage cleanup and cache identity protection were not justified by a normal reproduction here. [Task 2]
